title: Taiwanese Association of America Dallas-Fort Worth 達拉斯台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America Dallas-Fort Worth (TAA-DFW, 達拉斯台灣同鄉會) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex in Texas. TAA-DFW was founded in 1974 as a non-profit organization.
